vetSays.line: 🛡️ Hermann, Luis, Marta, Vasyl and Elif met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Luis, Marta, Vasyl, Elif are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Taha taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Taha passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Hermann, Marta, Vasyl and Lucas met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Hermann, Marta, Vasyl are hurt.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Booker, Hermann, Marta and Lucas met them at the door — 4 put down. Booker, Hermann, Marta, Lucas are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luis just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hermann, Luis, Marta, Vasyl and Elif met them at the door — 5 put down. Hermann, Luis, Marta are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Booker just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hermann just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marta just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Booker, Hermann, Luis, Marta and Vasyl met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Booker, Hermann, Luis, Marta, Vasyl are hurt.
✨ Ability gained: Cold-Blooded (L1). You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
🛡️ Ingrid met them at the door — 1 put down.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Zuweira was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Ethan showed Luis the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hermann just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Isaac just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Isaac met them at the door — 1 put down.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
